frases.dice: Your new model scores two points higher on a five hundred question benchmark. Is it better?
frases.muestra: Your new model scores 2 points higher on a 500-question benchmark. Is it better?
frases.es: Tu modelo nuevo saca 2 puntos más en un benchmark de 500 preguntas. ¿Es mejor?

frases.dice: The interval on that difference is plus or minus five points: you still do not know.
frases.muestra: The interval on that difference is ±4.9 points: you still do not know.
frases.es: El intervalo de esa diferencia es de ±4,9 puntos: todavía no lo sabes.

frases.dice: Tech capsule: evaluations, and red teaming.
frases.muestra: Tech capsule: evaluations and red teaming.
frases.es: Cápsula técnica: evaluaciones y red teaming.

frases.dice: Accuracy is a proportion, and it has a standard error: the square root of p times one minus p, over n.
frases.muestra: Accuracy is a proportion, and it has a standard error: √(p(1 − p)/n).
frases.es: Una precisión es una proporción, y tiene error estándar: √(p(1 − p)/n).

frases.dice: With a hundred questions, the margin is almost eight points. So: more questions, and compare models on the same questions, in pairs.
frases.muestra: With 100 questions, the margin is almost 8 points. So: more questions, and compare models on the same questions, in pairs.
frases.es: Con 100 preguntas, el margen es de casi 8 puntos. Por eso: más preguntas, y comparar los modelos sobre las mismas preguntas, en pares.

frases.dice: If the test questions leaked into training, the score lies. On a fresh set of grade school math, some models dropped up to eight points.
frases.muestra: If the test questions leaked into training, the score lies. On a fresh set of grade-school math, some models dropped up to 8 points.
frases.es: Si las preguntas del test se filtraron al entrenamiento, el puntaje miente. Con un set nuevo de matemáticas escolares, algunos modelos cayeron hasta 8 puntos.

frases.dice: You detect it by searching for repeated thirteen-word sequences, or by checking whether the model finds the text suspiciously easy.
frases.muestra: You detect it by searching for repeated 13-word sequences, or by checking whether the model finds the text suspiciously easy.
frases.es: Se detecta buscando secuencias de 13 palabras repetidas, o mirando si el modelo encuentra el texto sospechosamente fácil.

frases.dice: The defense: dynamic evaluations, with fresh questions written after the model's cutoff date.
frases.muestra: The defense: dynamic evaluations, with fresh questions written after the model's cutoff date.
frases.es: La defensa: evaluaciones dinámicas, con preguntas nuevas, posteriores a la fecha de corte del modelo.

frases.dice: And eval-driven development: write the evaluation before the change, like a test, and run it on every version.
frases.muestra: Eval-driven development: write the evaluation before the change, like a test, and run it on every version.
frases.es: Desarrollo guiado por evaluaciones: escribes la evaluación antes del cambio, como un test, y la corres en cada versión.

frases.dice: When an LLM is the judge, it brings biases: it prefers the first answer, the longest one, or its own.
frases.muestra: When an LLM is the judge, it brings biases: it prefers the first answer, the longest one, or its own.
frases.es: Cuando un LLM es el juez, trae sesgos: prefiere la primera respuesta, la más larga o la suya.

frases.dice: You calibrate it: swap the order, use a rubric, and measure its agreement with people. A good one passes eighty percent, like two humans with each other.
frases.muestra: You calibrate it: swap the order, use a rubric and measure its agreement with people. A good one passes 80%, like two humans with each other.
frases.es: Se calibra: intercambias el orden, usas una rúbrica y mides su acuerdo con personas. Uno bueno supera el 80 %, como dos humanos entre sí.

frases.dice: With a few human labels you can correct the judge: take its average over ten thousand cases, and subtract the bias measured on three hundred.
frases.muestra: With a few human labels you can correct the judge: take its average over 10,000 cases and subtract the bias measured on 300.
frases.es: Con pocas etiquetas humanas puedes corregir al juez: tomas su promedio en 10.000 casos y le restas el sesgo medido en 300.

frases.dice: The interval shrinks from four point eight to three point six points: like having five hundred forty human labels with only three hundred.
frases.muestra: The interval shrinks from ±4.8 to ±3.6 points: like having 543 human labels with only 300.
frases.es: El intervalo baja de ±4,8 a ±3,6 puntos: como tener 543 etiquetas humanas con solo 300.

frases.dice: Red teaming looks for failures on purpose: jailbreaks, and prompt injection hidden in documents or web pages.
frases.muestra: Red teaming looks for failures on purpose: jailbreaks, and prompt injection hidden in documents or web pages.
frases.es: El red teaming busca fallas a propósito: jailbreaks e inyección de instrucciones escondidas en documentos o páginas web.

frases.dice: There are automatic attacks: a gradient-optimized suffix can transfer to other models. The metric is the attack success rate.
frases.muestra: There are automatic attacks: a gradient-optimized suffix can transfer to other models. The metric is the attack success rate.
frases.es: Hay ataques automáticos: un sufijo optimizado por gradiente puede transferirse a otros modelos. La métrica es la tasa de éxito del ataque.

frases.dice: If a hundred attacks fail, is the risk zero? No. With a Beta prior, the plausible risk goes up to three percent.
frases.muestra: If 100 attacks fail, is the risk zero? No. With a Beta prior, the plausible risk goes up to 3%.
frases.es: Si 100 ataques fallan, ¿el riesgo es cero? No. Con una Beta como previo, el riesgo plausible llega hasta el 3 %.

frases.dice: It is the rule of three: with zero successes in n tries, the upper bound is three over n.
frases.muestra: It is the rule of three: with 0 successes in n tries, the upper bound is 3/n.
frases.es: Es la regla del tres: con 0 éxitos en n intentos, el límite superior es 3/n.

frases.dice: On Google Cloud, the Vertex AI evaluation service compares models with automatic judges, pointwise or pairwise. And Model Armor screens prompts and responses for injection and jailbreaks.
frases.muestra: On Google Cloud, the Vertex AI Gen AI evaluation service compares models with automatic judges, pointwise or pairwise. And Model Armor screens prompts and responses for injection and jailbreaks.
frases.es: En Google Cloud, el Gen AI evaluation service de Vertex AI compara modelos con jueces automáticos, puntuales o por pares. Y Model Armor revisa prompts y respuestas contra inyección y jailbreaks.

frases.dice: The basics: standard error and paired comparisons, contamination, calibrating the judge, and the Beta distribution.
frases.muestra: The basics: standard error and paired comparisons, contamination, calibrating the judge and the Beta distribution.
frases.es: Las bases: error estándar y comparaciones pareadas, contaminación, calibrar al juez y la distribución Beta.

frases.dice: If this helped, share and follow.
frases.muestra: If this helped, share and follow.
frases.es: Si te sirvió, compártelo y sígueme.
